content.comment_body: Hello, I'm seeking assistance because I'm using a program loaded via [product_name] [version_no] and a website developed with [product_name] [version_no] on a [company_name] logic module [article_no]. On our most recent devices ([article_no]), accessing the website is extremely difficult—the loading is either endless or takes much longer than usual. I've tested with various logic modules, network cables, memory cards, and PCs, and the issue seems related to the PLC version. Everything works on [article_no], but not on [article_no]. In both cases, the program and custom website (activated via web user in HTTP) are identical. The setup works well with all [article_no] modules running [version_no] firmware, but not with [article_no]. Starting from a fresh project with basic objects reproduces the same issue—the loading time is much slower. My final project contains more objects (not excessive), and while it's very fast on [article_no], it's practically inaccessible with [article_no]. Attached are images comparing loading times. Thank you. EDIT: Just saw [user_name] responded to this topic: [url]. No solution yet. [company_name] developers: Could HTTPS improve speed? If so, how do you enable it since it requires a certificate?

The [article_no] does not have firmware [version_no]. It runs firmware [version_no]. If you only post here on the forum, you likely won't get a response from [company_name]. For an official answer, please submit a Support Request. I've used HTTPS, and it's not faster. For installing the certificate, check the current manual, chapter 11.4 ([document]).

That's correct: [article_no] is on [version_no] and [article_no] is on [version_no]. I tried using HTTPS and it didn't help; in fact, loading became even slower. This is a major issue for me—I have two machines with embedded websites that users can no longer access since the switch to [article_no]. I contacted the [company_name] hotline, but they aren't seeing a problem. I've experimented with various hardware and PCs, and the issue is isolated to [article_no].

As mentioned in another topic: There's no solution. If support claims there's no issue, that information is incorrect. It's been noted since release that loading a [product_name] [version_no] project into [product_name] [version_no] takes much longer compared to [product_name] [version_no]. Depending on project type/size, projects run on [product_name] [version_no] in different browsers with errors or sometimes not at all. I've experienced this. Refer to the topic in the German section: Ladezeit des [product_name] Webservers bei RUN-Status extrem lange. Check the post from the account "[product_name] Support"; it's also an official statement by [company_name].
Any updates or progress regarding the certificate?
My last post in this thread was nine days ago. Are you hoping for any new developments?
The issue is unchanged even when using the certificate—if anything, it might be worse. I'll try [user_name]'s suggestion from this topic: [url].

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users report that web interface performance on [company_name] logic modules, specifically the [version_no], has significantly decreased compared to earlier versions like [version_no]. Accessing custom web pages using [product_name] is extremely slow or fails completely on newer hardware/firmware, while previous models work efficiently. Attempts to fix the problem using HTTPS, certificates, or changing hardware have not helped, indicating an ongoing compatibility or performance problem introduced with the [version_no] update.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the web interface to load quickly and reliably on the latest [company_name] logic module hardware, matching the performance of previous versions. They wish to transfer projects between firmware/hardware revisions without loss of functionality or usability in the web interface.
